inlines.v: CASTER, noun 1. One who throws or casts; one who computes; a calculator; one who calculates fortunes. 2. A small phial or vessel for the table; as a set of casters. 3. A small wheel on a swivel, on which furniture is cast, or rolled, on the floor.
